topic: Decide how to spend the hiking club year-end surplus

scenario.topic: Decide how to spend the hiking club year-end surplus
scenario.opening_question: How should we best invest our surplus to enhance our future hiking experiences?

options.name: High-Quality Group Tent for 4 People
options.upside: Provides reliable shelter for all members during multi-day hikes
options.tradeoff: Heavy to carry and requires storage space
options.concern: Some members may prefer individual tents for privacy
options.best_for: Improving group camping comfort and protection

options.name: Annual National Park Pass for All Members
options.upside: Reduces entrance fees for all hikes planned in national parks
options.tradeoff: Does not cover other expenses like permits or camping fees
options.concern: Limited benefit if hikes are outside national parks
options.best_for: Saving money on park access for frequent hikes

options.name: Professional Outdoor Skills Workshop for Group
options.upside: Improves safety and skills for all members on future hikes
options.tradeoff: Takes a full day and requires scheduling availability
options.concern: Some members may feel they already have sufficient skills
options.best_for: Enhancing group competence and safety knowledge

options.name: Lightweight Portable Camping Stove Set
options.upside: Enables hot meals and drinks on all hikes with minimal weight
options.tradeoff: Requires ongoing purchase of fuel canisters
options.concern: Some members prefer cold meals or open fires
options.best_for: Improving convenience and comfort during hikes

shared_context: The hiking club has a year-end surplus of $1200
The group size is exactly 4 members
The goal is to spend the surplus on something that benefits all members and improves club activities

personas.name: Nico
personas.background: I enjoy group hikes in national parks and want to reduce costs on entrance fees for everyone.
personas.private_goal: To make hiking more affordable and accessible for all club members.

personas.name: Daria
personas.background: I prioritize safety and skill development to ensure our hikes are well-prepared and secure.
personas.private_goal: To enhance the group's outdoor skills and reduce risks during hikes.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

personas.name: Juno
personas.background: I value convenience and comfort on hikes, especially lightweight gear that improves the experience.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
